evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce SteerSearch, an RL framework that trains on interactive search trajectories with injected interventions to enable context-preserving target reassignment, and SteerSearch-Bench, a benchmark adapted from multi-hop QA datasets.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: We identify answer-target anchoring, a failure mode in which fixed-query search agents retrieve evidence for the updated request but still answer an earlier question.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Without CCR, SteerSearch improves average steering accuracy over Search-R1 from 11.1% to 31.3% on Qwen2.5-3B and from 36.6% to 44.6% on Qwen3-4B, while preserving standard single-query performance.
